description: A signed-in user lists their own rows, public and authenticated rows

output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM `post` AS `post_view` WHERE ((`post_view`.`owner` = ? OR `post_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated')))

SELECT
  `post_view`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `post_view`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `post_view`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `post_view`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `post_view`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `post_view`.`heading` AS `heading`,
  (CASE WHEN `post_view`.`author_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`author_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`author_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`author_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`author_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`post_view`.`author_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `author_id`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`) FROM `author` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `post_view`.`author_id` LIMIT 1) AS `author`
FROM `post` AS `post_view` WHERE ((`post_view`.`owner` = ? OR `post_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated'))) ORDER BY `post_view`.`id` ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
